outline.classes: x1motxo8 x1dg8jwx x3a6nna xm5vtmc x1t2x7uc x1o1n6r0 x1366vqa
outline.text: This policy covers two categories of ads: Adult Products and Reproductive Health. Ads promoting or marketing dietary, health, or weight loss or weight gain products and services must be targeted to people at least 18 years or older. Ads must not contain certain claims prohibited by our policy, as outlined below.
Health and Wellbeing

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x13hqrlb x1
outline.text: Ads promoting or marketing cosmetic products, procedures or surgeries, must be targeted to people at least 18 years or older.

outline.classes: x19a1ety x1dg8jwx xjliv6m x1yxlzaz xsp84uj x1uc5f31 x1366vqa
outline.text: Overview

outline.classes: x1motxo8 x1dg8jwx x3a6nna xm5vtmc x1t2x7uc x1o1n6r0 x1366vqa
outline.text: Meta restricts advertising content that promotes weight loss or weight gain products, cosmetic procedures, and dietary or health supplements from targeting users under 18 years of age. Content must not contain certain claims prohibited by our policy, as outlined below.

outline.classes: x1motxo8 x1dg8jwx x3a6nna xm5vtmc x1t2x7uc x1o1n6r0 x1366vqa
outline.text: Advertisers must follow our , in addition to our Advertising Standards.

outline.classes: x1i10hfl x1qjc9v5 xjbqb8w xjqpnuy xc5r6h4 xqeqjp1 x1phubyo x
outline.text: Community Standards

outline.classes: x19a1ety x1dg8jwx xjliv6m x1yxlzaz xsp84uj x1uc5f31 x1366vqa
outline.text: Guidelines

outline.classes: x1motxo8 x1dg8jwx x3a6nna xm5vtmc x1t2x7uc x1o1n6r0 x1366vqa
outline.text: Ads can’t:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Promote weight loss or weight gain products and services, or cosmetic products or procedures that:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Contains statements of inferiority about physical appearance (i.e., terms, descriptions, or questions that are negative and attack an individual’s appearance, specific body parts, or hygiene).

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Promote weight loss or weight gain products or services, that depict:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Close up on specific body area by pinching fat

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Claims that results can be achieved solely by using wearable products

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Promote skin whitening or bleaching products that cause permanent skin color change.

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Claims (including those from health professionals or health organizations) to cure, heal, or eliminate any of the following incurable diseases and/or terminal illnesses (exhaustive list): Diabetes, Herpes, Thyroid, Psoriasis, Ebola, Cancer, Autism, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) Note: This does not apply to claims about treating or

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Employ clickbait tactics in a health, weight loss, or weight gain context, such as sensational language with exaggerated or extreme claims, or promises of specific outcomes within a set timeframe without disclaimers or qualifiers.

outline.classes: x1motxo8 x1dg8jwx x3a6nna xm5vtmc x1t2x7uc x1o1n6r0 x1366vqa
outline.text: When targeting people 18 years or older, advertisers can run ads that promote:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Dietary weight loss or weight gain products and services such as supplements or pills. The ad can illustrate people using the product or the service, and its impact of using it, and clearly indicate the time taken to achieve noticeable results.

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Cosmetic products, procedures, or surgeries such as:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Breast augmentation, breast reduction, abdominoplasty, blepharoplasty, rhinoplasty, rhytidectomy, labiaplasty, hair restoration surgery, dermal fillers, skin rejuvenation treatments, injectable treatments, chemical peels, micro-needling, non-ablative laser treatments, laser or light treatments, or micropigmentation

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: General cosmetic products, procedures, surgeries depicting before and after transformation.
Note: For weight loss products that require prescription, please refer to Drugs and Pharmaceuticals ads policy and comply with the geo-targeting, and written permission requirements.
The age targeting restrictions above don’t apply to ads that promote or sell:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Products and services marketed for general wellbeing, such as fitness services and equipments, health clubs

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: General food products, including protein products

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Non-permanent cosmetic and beauty products such as creams, makeup, hair products, and digital editing apps

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Dental products, such as teeth whitening products

outline.classes: x1motxo8 x1dg8jwx x1r28tcg x1yxlzaz xsp84uj x1tbo4zr x1366vq
outline.text: Adult Products and Reproductive Health

outline.classes: x1motxo8 x1dg8jwx x3a6nna xm5vtmc x1t2x7uc x1o1n6r0 x1366vqa
outline.text: Ads must not promote the sale or use of adult sexual arousal products or services, provided that the ads are focused on health and wellness, not sexual pleasure or enhancements, and are targeted to people 18 years or older.

outline.classes: x19a1ety x1dg8jwx xjliv6m x1yxlzaz xsp84uj x1uc5f31 x1366vqa
outline.text: Overview

outline.classes: x1motxo8 x1dg8jwx x3a6nna xm5vtmc x1t2x7uc x1o1n6r0 x1366vqa
outline.text: Advertisers can run ads that promote sexual health, wellness and reproductive products and services. However, as a global company, we need to take into account the wide array of people from different cultures and countries who see ads across our technologies to avoid potential negative experiences. That is why we place additional restrictions on these ads, including the requirement to target audie

outline.classes: x19a1ety x1dg8jwx xjliv6m x1yxlzaz xsp84uj x1uc5f31 x1366vqa
outline.text: Guidelines

outline.classes: x1motxo8 x1dg8jwx x3a6nna xm5vtmc x1t2x7uc x1o1n6r0 x1366vqa
outline.text: Ads can't:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Promote sexual arousal products that focus on sexual pleasure or enhancement, such as:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Sex toys

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Erotic products (e.g., erotic novels or poems promoted or marketed as primarily sexual in content; erotic costumes, cosmetics, or fetish items; and non-surgical genital enhancement products)

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Promote the sale or use of adult sexual services, including but not limited to:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Adult entertainment businesses, such as strip clubs

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Adult establishments, such as cabarets, adult movie theaters, and hotels for sexual fantasies

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Instructional sexual services, such as tantric services, orgasmic therapy or tantric retreats for orgasmic therapy

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Promote genital procedures or surgeries focused on sexual pleasure, such as G-spot augmentation, male genitalia enlargement.

outline.classes: x1motxo8 x1dg8jwx x3a6nna xm5vtmc x1t2x7uc x1o1n6r0 x1366vqa
outline.text: When targeting people 18 years or older, advertisers can run ads that:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Promote sexual and reproductive health and wellness products or services, as long as the focus is on health and the medical efficacy of the product or the service and not on the sexual pleasure or enhancement. And these ads must target people 18 years or older. This includes ads for:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Products addressing sexual reproductive disorders or health issues, such as:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Prevention of erectile dysfunction

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Premature ejaculation

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Hypoactive Sexual Desire Disorder (HSDD)

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Pain relief during sex

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: The effects of menopause

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Reproductive genital surgeries that address medical benefits, limited to:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Male circumcision

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Vaginoplasty

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Vasectomy

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Gender reassignment surgeries

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Contraceptive products, including condoms

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Lube and pheromones

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Women’s reproductive health apps, such as:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Femtech apps

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Ovulation tracker

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Pregnancy progress tracker

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Family planning methods, such as:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Family planning clinics

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) or any other artificial insemination procedures

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Fertility awareness

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Abortion medical consultation and related services

Note: For Reproductive health and wellness drugs or treatments that require prescription, please refer to Drugs and Pharmaceuticals ads policy and comply with the geo-targeting, and written permission requirements in addition to this policy.
The age targeting requirements above don’t apply to ads that promote or sell:

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Women’s reproductive health products, such as menstruation tracking health apps

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Sex education that shares reproductive health or sexual health awareness in an informational, educational, or documentary, as long as there’s no sexualized or suggestive content, and the focus is on health and not sexual pleasure or enhancement

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Educational material or information about family planning services without any direct promotion or facilitation of the services

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Women’s hygiene products

outline.classes: xeuugli x2lwn1j x78zum5 xig2svb x18vy5xy xlluq36 x178p66w xc
outline.text: Lingerie, swimwear, or undergarments, as long as they do not violate the Adult Nudity and Sexual Activity policy.
